title: Delectatio et Dominium
tagline: Bedroom drama for SkyrimNet: NPCs who flirt, grab, fight, pose, mark, rob and spare you, because the AI decided they would. Modular, for SexLab and OStim.
description:
**Delectatio et Dominium (DeD)** is a modular SkyrimNet integration for classic adult Skyrim mods. The LLM driving your NPCs doesn't just know what is happening: it reacts as the character would, narrates it in-story, and decides what happens next. Often DeD drives the mods itself: it starts paired animations and scenes, applies tattoos and cum decals, and downs the loser of a fight. It supports both SexLab and OStim. Adult content (18+).

### What it makes possible
- **One menu for everything:** cast DeD Interact (a minor power in your magic menu) or press the Open DeD key, and a combined menu opens on what fits: interactions, poses, tattoos, the downed menu, or a grapple mid-combat.
- **Baka Interactions:** hugs, kisses, flirting, groping and harassment, escalation with struggles and a QTE, capture, tie-up, creatures, spanking (also during a scene), and narrated cum.
- **DeD Downed (new in 0.6.0):** beaten, not dead. Lose a fight and the winners decide what happens next: rob you, threaten you, start a scene, or worse. You set how often each outcome happens. Companions can heal you back into the fight, help you up, or take advantage if you allow it; beaten enemies can be talked into standing down. Replaces Acheron.
- **The daedric modes:** Mephala and Molag Bal let dominant NPCs escalate on their own initiative; Sanguine and Sheogorath have the room strike mood-fitting poses. Each moment can land as narration, nearby thoughts, words aimed at you, or your own thoughts.
- **GS Poses:** a pose grid with 19 categories for you or any NPC, plus AI pose actions.
- **SlaveTats:** tattoos and makeup with a live preview, and descriptions the AI can read so NPCs know what a mark shows.
- **Fill Her Up:** inflation, narrated as it happens.

### Built to be modular
Every module is its own installer option, nothing requires another module, and every feature can be dialled down or switched off. No DeD action ever targets a child.

### Requirements
SkyrimNet 0.25 or later, Magelight UI 1.9.0 or newer, SKSE, SkyUI, PapyrusUtil, the Baka Motion Data Pack, and SexLab or OStim. Per module: GSPoses, Fill Her Up Baka Edition, SlaveTats. Recommended: SkyrimNet-SexLab Integration or OStimNet for scene hand-off.

Full details, requirements and installation are on the GitHub page.
author: 7regalrascal7
changelog:
**0.6.0 - Beaten, Not Dead.** DeD Downed replaces Acheron: losing a fight downs you instead of killing you, and the winners decide what happens next (robbery, threats, a scene, or worse), weighted by your settings. Companions can heal you, help you up or take advantage; beaten enemies can be talked into standing down; restraints, and a Wounded effect until you sleep.

Also includes 0.5.0: one combined DeD menu on Magelight UI (PrismaUI is no longer needed), a tattoo and makeup overhaul with live preview and descriptions the AI can read, scene hand-off to SkyrimNet-SexLab Integration and OStimNet, and spanking during scenes.

Upgrading from 0.4.x: install into a new mod folder and untick SkyrimNet_AcheronIntegration.esp; keep Acheron switched off in its MCM, or remove it after Prepare to Remove Acheron in the DeD MCM.
